Boat Charters

Snorkel. Lounge. Slide.

#1 Rated St. John Boat Charter

US Virgin Islands Boat Charter Company

#1 Boat Trip and Outdoor Activity out of Coral Bay, St. John on Trip Advisor

Justin (a US Navy Veteran) & Kate (2008 US Olympian), now have 6 boats in their Salty Daze fleet! 3 Salt Decks (double-decker pontoons), Salt Shaker and Knot E Buoys (power vessels), and the official public shuttle to Lime Out, SALT + LIME Express. Every St. John boat charter is decked out with you and yours in mind for ultimate fun and endless comfort. Our entire fleet and each of our Captains are legitimate, legal, and permitted within the US Coast Guard regulations and National Park. With us, you can have peace of mind cruising through the Caribbean’s finest waters with your family and friends safely. Want to Sport Fish? We can recommend some of the best fishing companies on the island!

Meet The Crew

Check Out The Boats!

Fleet of 6

3 Salt Decks, Salt + Lime Express, Salt Shaker, and Knot E Buoys. We have plenty of private boat options and a new per-person option to Lime Out! Large party? Inquire about our tandem options – we can now host up to 48!

Professional and Friendly Crew

Qualified Captains with decades of local knowledge, advanced licensing, while being exceptional with your families and little ones.

Convenient boarding and pickup

Easy, FREE parking at our convenient pick-up location in Coral Bay, St. John.

Discover Coral Bay and beyond

Discover the unrivaled beauty of Coral Bay, our home port. With rich history, turquoise waters, and abundant underwater life. Looking to see more of the USVI? Let us take you there, you won’t regret it.

Something Special For Your St John Boat Charter.

You’ve been daydreaming about this vacation for months and you get one day to splurge on an unforgettable boat day to relax and celebrate with the people you love most…so why choose us?

We created this business with our children, their grandparents, and our friends in mind. We love boat days with our kids just as much as we love those days drinking and relaxing with friends. We cherish our Coral Bay community and the beautiful ocean waters we’re so lucky to explore daily. Our team of Captains is our “chosen” family, which we have carefully tailored to ensure your family’s safety and the best, happy vibes.

So why choose us? Because we have thought of everything, we care about everything, and we want our family to be a part of creating happy memories with yours!
